widgets_values:
### Resolution and Enablers

- Start by generating a 720x480 video to see if your setup can handle it! Then increase the resolution to your liking!


- Use **'Extensions Enabler'** to decide how many times you want to extend the video!


- Use **'Interpolation Enabler'** to decide where do you want video interpolation to happen. The longer the video the more memory the interpolation process will require.

nodes.title: Note+
widgets_values:
### INTERPOLATION

- If you have another preferred interpolation method just substitute the node inside the box so you can turn it 'on' and off' with the **'Interpolation Enabler'**.

nodes.title: +note
widgets_values:
# Video Setup  


Here is what you need to setup your video:

1. **Duration:** Choose the duration (in seconds) of each video. Its set to '5' by default.

2. **Upscaler:** Choose upscaling method and how much to scale by. Upscale method is set to lanczos and its scaled by '2' default. a 480x720 video will result in a 960x1440 video!

3. **High and Low Loras:** You can set a pair of High and Low loras for the inital video and each extension.

4. **Prompts:** Write the Positive Prompt for the video and your extensions. Leave the Default Negative - add anything you need in it but I recommend always leaving the default negative text!

5. **Seeds:** The inital seed (noise_seed) on 'Initial Ksampler' on first video can be set freely or set to randomize. Its set to 'randomize' by default.
- The seed on '1ª Extension KSampler' can be set freely. Its set to 1000 by default. The other extensions will get the value of that Seed + 1 - Therefore, by default, Extensions 1 to 5 will have the seed 1000 to 1005 respectively. This ensures that the video will propely be generated.

6. **KSampler:** You can set up the Steps, Sampler and Scheduler for your videos and extensions separately. Feel free to experiment!

7. **NAG KSamplers:** Every video has a NAG KSampler. It allows the Negative Prompts have an effect while the CFG is set to 1.0. CFG is set to '1.0' by default. 
- The parameter 'nag_scale' controls the intensity of the negative guidance applied to the video generation. I recommend using anywhere between 15 and 50 - The ideal value will change depending on the Models and Loras you are using. 'nag_scale' is set to 30 by defaulty as its my recommended value for generating using 'SmoothMix I2V v.2'. Feel free to change and experiment! 

- *More advanced users can open the subgraph and change 'nag_tau', 'nag_alpha' and 'nag_sigma_end'.*

nodes.title: Note+
widgets_values:
### Models Setup 

- Set the High and LOW Models!

- Set the SVI Pro Loras on their High and LOW area.

- If you are using Light/Speed Loras set them on their High and LOW area.

- 'ModelSamplingSD3' is set 'shift' 8 since in testing this was be the most reliable value to maintain quality and prompt adherence. If you are planning on making a long video - past 'Extension 3' - set the shift to '12'.
